abstract_sentences.text: Existing language model benchmarks provide contradictory model rankings, even for benchmarks that aim to capture similar skills.
This dilemma of conflicting rankings hampers model selection, clouds model comparisons, and adds confusion to a growing ecosystem of competing models.

In this paper, we take a different perspective on model comparison: instead of relying on out-of-the-box performance via direct evaluation, we compare model potential by providing each model with identical benchmark-specific fine-tuning before evaluation.
Our primary contribution is a comprehensive empirical evaluation of model potential across 24 benchmarks and 61 models.
First, we demonstrate that model potential rankings obtained through train-before-test exhibit remarkable consistency across all benchmarks.

Whereas traditional rankings demonstrate little external validity under direct evaluation, they enjoy a significant degree of external validity when applying train-before-test: model potential rankings transfer gracefully from one benchmark to another.
Second, train-before-test restores the connection between perplexity and downstream task performance, lost under direct evaluation.

Remarkably, even pre-finetuning perplexity of a base model predicts post-finetuning downstream performance, suggesting that ranking consistency reflects inherent model potential rather than fine-tuning artifacts.

evidence.anchor: pre-finetuning perplexity of a base model predicts

abstract_sentences.text: Finally, train-before-test reduces the model-score matrix to essentially rank one, indicating that model potential is dominated by one latent factor, uncovered by train-before-test.
While direct evaluation remains useful for assessing deployment-ready performance, train-before-test provides a complementary lens for understanding achievable performance of models after adaptation.

final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 24 benchmark/61 model 范围、direct/TBT 对照、训练流程、总体 τ、perplexity 对齐、base 预测和 PC1 主结果，以及两种评价用途边界。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 筛选、LoRA/GPU/chat-template、完整 pair matrix、Gemma 异常、size/family/few-shot 分层、τ-b/t-test 和 ranking algorithms 后置；正文理解方法可自足，但复现和异质性判断依赖附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 先以同一对 QA benchmark 做 direct/TBT 对照，Figures 2–3 扩展到总体/类别，Figures 4–8 再推进到 perplexity 与 score-matrix 结构；图注给出聚合对象。
final_judgment.largest_gap: TBT 同时改变 task preparation、PEFT、checkpoint/learning-rate selection 和输入模板；没有组件级对照来识别 equalized preparedness 的独立机制，latent factor/external validity 也主要是观察性解释。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 声称跨任务 ranking validity 时，固定模型集合与任务准备协议，同时报告全 pair 矩阵、总体聚合和关键异质性分层。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于有公开 training data、可重复适应且 ranking 是核心 estimand 的 benchmark；对 immediate deployment、闭源模型、无训练集或真实应用分布，TBT 不能替代 direct evaluation。
